label: RB-001 Part 27: observed SITL-vs-real differences only

receipts.assumption: every PX4 log has PX4 547e2ca's estimator_status schema
receipts.impact_on_csia: no report at all on other PX4 versions
receipts.model_limitation: one contract per PX4 schema version
receipts.physical_behavior: 6/6 reachable real/older logs lack fields (accel_device_id, hdg_test_ratio): the stock path CRASHED (KeyError)
receipts.product_consequence: FIXED narrowly: a schema mismatch is a coverage notice and the estimator producer is not run (runs.stock_flight); test in tests/test_rb001_reality_bridge.py; historical outputs unchanged
receipts.sitl_behavior: all 2.2/2.3 logs had it; the stock path ran

receipts.assumption: an ordinary PX4 log carries actuator_motors and esc_status at 547e2ca's default rates
receipts.impact_on_csia: no propulsion evidence on older vehicles; 0-1 of 29 profile records observed
receipts.model_limitation: the stock bridge needs PX4 >= control allocation and ESC telemetry
receipts.physical_behavior: absent on all 4 real boards (pre-control-allocation PX4); a newer SITL log logs esc_status at 4 Hz
receipts.product_consequence: reported honestly (coverage notices); state the supported PX4 range in the product documentation

receipts.impact_on_csia: windows over a dropout must be refused
receipts.physical_behavior: 3 of 4 real logs have dropouts: 4 (119 ms), 1 (10 ms), 1 (30 ms)
receipts.product_consequence: already handled: LOG_COMPLETENESS flagged 6/6 real dropouts

receipts.assumption: sample spacing is regular at the default interval
receipts.impact_on_csia: real faults may go unreported on real, jittery logs (an honest refusal, but a miss)
receipts.physical_behavior: real boards: 1.4-16 ms jitter at 100 ms, gaps up to 164 ms; applied to a SITL loss log, the product's default-rate re-decimation creates gaps above the 3-interval rule and the motor loss (C = 0.664) is refused
receipts.product_consequence: SPECIFIED, NOT APPLIED: re-decimate only topics logged faster than their default; measure gaps against the log's own median interval. Gate: the first real propulsion log
receipts.sitl_behavior: actuator_outputs jitter about 0-9 ms; largest gaps 4-16 ms

receipts.assumption: the logging rate is PX4 547e2ca's default
receipts.physical_behavior: rates differ by version and by logging profile (esc_status 4 Hz in a newer SITL log; CubeOrange's reduced profile logs actuator_outputs at about 9 Hz with 16 ms jitter); at 2 Hz (stress) every propulsion window is refused

receipts.assumption: the peak body rate measures maneuvering only
receipts.impact_on_csia: on a real vehicle the compensation may never be assessable (NOT_STEADY_FLIGHT everywhere)
receipts.model_limitation: a maximum is the wrong statistic under noise; remove the window median or use PX4's bias-corrected rate
receipts.physical_behavior: real boards at rest: 5 s peaks above 0.0989 rad/s in some windows on all three disarmed boards; a 0.067 rad/s uncorrected yaw bias on a CubeOrange at rest
receipts.product_consequence: recalibrate and redefine on RB3/RB5 data before relying on the compensation outside SITL
receipts.sitl_behavior: SIH hover nulls max 0.049 rad/s; theta_steady 0.0989

receipts.impact_on_csia: lane switches and IMU-instance lineage changes happen on hardware; the frozen lane-switch design becomes runnable without a simulator change
receipts.physical_behavior: a real CubeOrange logs three gyro, three accelerometer and two magnetometer instances
receipts.product_consequence: lineage roots must name the selected IMU instance (2.2 already does); run the lane-switch design on a multi-IMU board (HIL_AND_LANE_SWITCH.md)
receipts.sitl_behavior: SIH: one IMU, one magnetometer, no lane switch possible

receipts.model_limitation: ESC telemetry latency is still unmeasured (no sample time in esc_status)
receipts.physical_behavior: 0.40 ms median, 0.44 ms p99 on a real CubeOrange (vehicle_angular_velocity)
receipts.product_consequence: keep 2.2 content time for IMU-derived outputs; measure ESC latency at RB2-0
